Indian Companies Report Mixed Financial Results for Q1

Several Indian companies have released their first-quarter financial results, showing varied performance. Avenue Supermarts experienced slower growth in mature stores and increased costs, impacting margins, despite an overall rise in net profit and revenue. L&T Finance reported a significant 31% increase in net profit, driven by strong retail book growth. These results offer a snapshot of the current business environment for key sectors.
